toolchains.name: cc
toolchains.title: C and C++ (zig cc), CMake, Ninja
toolchains.description: cc, c++, gcc, g++, clang, clang++, ar and ranlib as zig cc (Clang with Zig's own libc headers, libc++ and linker: programs are built against the glibc of the sandbox they are built in, or static with -target x86_64-linux-musl), CMake 4.4.4 and Ninja 1.13.2 (CMake's generator here: there is no make). It is Clang: no GNU binutils (nm, objdump), libc++ instead of libstdc++.
toolchains.license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-3-Clause AND Apache-2.0

toolchains.name: dotnet
toolchains.title: .NET SDK 10
toolchains.description: The .NET 10 SDK (LTS): dotnet with the C#, F# and Visual Basic compilers, MSBuild and NuGet. Packages and state go to ~/.nuget and ~/.dotnet. Telemetry is off. Globalization runs in invariant mode unless you set DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=0 and the system has ICU. Workloads (dotnet workload install) cannot be added: the toolchain is read-only.
